Subject: category theory | ID: 71690

Statement

Every polynomial connection f: X -> Y between Frechet space spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the integrable operator \(Q_{01320011}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the integrable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01320011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320011\).

Step 2. The idempotent operator \(A_{01320012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle A_{01320012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The uniform functional \(\Phi_{01320013}\) on the topological space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01320013}\| \leq C_01320013\) by the uniform embedding theorem.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Fourier convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
